unit: Geometry · Chapter II. Vectors in space
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 11 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: A vector is a directed segment: AB starts at A and ends at B; its length is the modulus |AB|.
stages.headlineEnglish: A vector is a directed segment: AB starts at A and ends at B; its length is the modulus |AB|.

stages.headline: Vectors in space are defined as in the plane; the zero vector has equal start and end and modulus 0.
stages.headlineEnglish: Vectors in space are defined as in the plane; the zero vector has equal start and end and modulus 0.

stages.headline: Nonzero vectors are collinear if they lie on one line or on parallel lines; collinear vectors are co-directed or opposite.
stages.headlineEnglish: Nonzero vectors are collinear if they lie on one line or on parallel lines; collinear vectors are co-directed or opposite.
